# Repository instructions

The canonical development and UI/UX convention is `/AGENTS.md`. Read and follow it before proposing or applying changes. For UI work, also read `/docs/design-system.md`; its dual-theme Signal Workspace system is the canonical light/dark token, chart, glow, card, elevation, typography, and frost contract.

In particular: preserve data meaning; use semantic design tokens instead of raw component colors; reserve red for actual breaches/errors; keep pacing language accurate; implement all interaction states; maintain keyboard/accessibility support; verify responsive behavior; and run the required checks in `AGENTS.md`.
